soldier: Body medium-sized; head brown tinged with yellow, the antennae and mandibular bases yellowish brown, the thorax, abdomen and legs pale yellowish brown. Pilosity of the head sparse, the labral-margin setae in four or five pairs. Head oval, the cephalic index 0.72–0.79, the lateral margins slightly straight and slightly expanding posteriorly, the posterior margin rounded, widest at the posterior quarter of the head, about 1.4–1.6 times the width at the mandibular bases. Labrum lingulate. Mandibles sickle-shaped, slender and curved at both ends; the left mandible about half the head length, with a tooth at one-third of the anterior part whose apex points forwards and forms an acute angle of 60 degrees with the inner margin, and with a fine tooth behind the midpoint and another in front of the mandibular basal projection; the right mandible with two fine teeth on the inner margin. Antennae with 16–17 segments, segment 3 or segment 4 the shortest. Postmentum about 1.7–1.9 times as long as wide, the anterior quarter slightly trapezoidal, the sides of the middle section nearly parallel, the middle of the lower margin in lateral view slightly arched. Pronotum saddle-shaped, about 1.6 times as wide as long, with shallow median concavities on the anterior and posterior margins; the posterior margin of the mesonotum is similarly shallowly concave, whereas that of the metanotum is nearly straight.
